summary: Nora can play, skip, stop and check Discord music conversationally, not just via /music commands.
details: Four new Discord-only agent tools: play_music, skip_music, stop_music, music_status. Ask her directly ("play apt", "skip this", "what's playing") or hand her a link; for a vaguer request ("play some kpop") she can search the web for a real playlist first, then play it -- ordinary multi-tool reasoning, no new plumbing.

Every tool refuses outside Discord, with no guessing: off-platform, with music not configured, or when she can't resolve who's asking to a real Discord account, she says she can't play music rather than pretending to.
play_music still requires being in a voice channel to START a fresh session -- the same rule the /music play slash command already enforces (R-59), never bypassed by this new surface.
limitations: Pause/resume/volume stay slash-command-only for now; promoted the same way play/skip/stop/status were, if asked for conversationally often enough.
